fresh_source_evidence.fact: Current INSPIRE Index Polygons release is published 5 July 2026.
New INSPIRE files are published on the first Sunday of every month.
INSPIRE data is supplied as local-authority GML files and is available under the Open Government Licence.
INSPIRE polygons show indicative position and extent; definitive registered-title extent cannot be established from INSPIRE alone.
Each INSPIRE polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID and a title may contain several separate polygons.
A polygon on a local-authority boundary can appear in both authority files, so identity deduplication is required.
HMLR geometry is captured against British National Grid; BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection can shift some features by up to 15 metres.
LIDAR Composite DTM 1m covers about 99% of England at 1m spatial resolution.
The DTM removes surface objects from the DSM to model the terrain surface.
Repeat-survey composite selection uses newest best-resolution data and bilinear interpolation where resampling is needed.
The DTM CRS is EPSG:27700 and metadata survey-index services identify the contributing survey for a location.
The published vertical accuracy is +/-15cm RMSE.
The persistent DTM1m WCS endpoint supports WCS 2.0.1 and is intended to provide the most up-to-date composite.
LiDAR Composite downloads include a GeoPackage spatial metadata index describing raster spatial location and temporal extent.
OS Terrain 50 is an Open Data DTM updated annually in July and supplied in 10km tiles with 50m grid spacing.
OS Terrain 50 grid data is verified to 4m RMSE.
Terrain50 ASCII grid supply uses 200 by 200 pixels at 50m spacing, values to 0.1m, and includes GML, PRJ and Metadata_<tile>.xml companions.
The current known-data-issues page reports no live known data issues for OS Terrain 50.
